# Party Cat

> Party Cat is a free web app for planning a party: an RSVP tracker with automatic headcounts, a to-do list and a shopping list in one place. It works in any browser with no sign-up; an optional free account syncs a party across devices.

- Free, with no ads, paid tiers or guest limits
- No account needed: without one, data stays in the visitor's own browser (localStorage)
- Optional account: data is stored on Party Cat's server and only the owner can see it; no data selling or tracking cookies
- Headcount detection: "Sam & Alex" counts as 2 people, "Mateo, Ben, Ava" as 3, "The Smiths family" as 4
- Four visual themes: Confetti, Astro Cat, Loose Thread, Calm Cat
- Made by Maeve Lander; open source
